blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Event cameras provide a high dynamic range and preserve brightness-change cues in lighting conditions where conventional RGB frames may be noisy or saturated.
To benchmark event-guided restoration across a broad illumination range, we organized the SEE Challenge 2026 with the Event-Based Multimodal Vision Workshop at ECCV 2026.
The task conditions restoration on one or more RGB frames, synchronized events, and a scalar target-brightness statistic provided by the organizers.
It uses SEE-600K, which contains 610,126 image-event observations from 202 real-world scenes spanning low-light, normal-light, and high-light conditions with illumination variations of up to 1,000 × \times .
The challenge follows an open-system protocol: participants may use different temporal contexts, architectures, pretrained weights, test-time augmentation, and post-processing strategies.
PSNR determines the ranking, and SSIM is reported as a secondary metric.
Around 70 teams registered interest and 15 valid CodaBench submissions were received.
Six distinct teams completed organizer-side identity and technical verification, provided method descriptions, checkpoints, inference code, and instructions, and are included in the verified open-system ranking reported here.
Beyond the ranking, this report analyzes exposure subsets, semantically distinct test cases, a shared failure pattern, system design choices, and inference strategies.
The top systems obtain closely spaced average scores, while the best-performing method varies across cases and metrics; under severe underexposure, all verified systems retain visible local errors.
More details are available at SEE Challenge 2026 .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Visual systems often encounter illumination changes that exceed the dynamic range of conventional cameras [ 12 ] .
Mobile robots may move from dim indoor spaces to sunlit entrances, while autonomous vehicles may encounter tunnels, reflective roads, and bright headlights within the same sequence [ 6 , 17 ] .
Under these conditions, dark regions can be dominated by noise and bright regions can become saturated.
Once useful measurements have been severely degraded, recovering faithful structure and color from an RGB image alone becomes difficult.
blocks.zh:
视觉系统经常遇到超过常规相机动态范围的照明变化[12].
移动机器人可能从阴暗的室内空间移动到阳光照亮的入口,而自主车辆则可能遇到隧道,反射道路,以及相同序列内的明亮前灯[6,17].
在这些情况下,黑暗区域会受到噪音的支配,亮区域会变得饱和.
一旦有用的测量严重退化,就很难从RGB图像中恢复忠实的结构和颜色。

(b) SEE-600K spans low-light, normal-light, and high-light conditions. (c) Earlier low-light methods map dark inputs to a fixed normal-light target. blocks.en:
This problem has motivated extensive work in computational photography and image restoration [ 8 , 16 , 9 , 20 ] .
Multi-exposure high dynamic range imaging combines observations captured at different exposure levels, but remains sensitive to scene motion and alignment [ 10 , 11 , 18 ] .
Learning-based approaches address low-light enhancement, exposure correction, RAW reconstruction, and image signal processing using learned priors [ 19 , 1 , 5 , 2 ] .
Nevertheless, a frame-based method must infer missing information from measurements that may already be clipped or noise-dominated [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
这个问题促使在计算摄影和图像恢复方面开展了广泛的工作[8、16、9、20]。
多接触高动态射程成像结合了在不同接触水平上捕获的观测,但对场景运动和对齐仍然敏感[10,11,18].
基于学习的方法涉及低光增强、曝光校正、RAW重建,以及利用学到的前兆处理图像信号[19、1、5、2]。
然而,基于帧的方法必须推断出可能已经剪辑或以噪音为主的测量中缺少的信息[7]。

blocks.en:
Event cameras asynchronously record per-pixel brightness changes and provide complementary measurements [ 3 ] .
Their high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range can preserve contrast and motion cues when conventional frames are degraded.
Events do not directly provide dense color or absolute brightness, so restoration requires the fusion of RGB appearance, event changes, and a definition of the desired target exposure.
Previous event-guided low-light studies, including EvLowLight [ 13 ] and EvLight [ 4 ] , have provided experimental evidence that event measurements can complement RGB inputs in difficult illumination.
SEE-Net [ 15 ] subsequently extended this setting from fixed low-to-normal enhancement to brightness adjustment across low, normal, and bright exposures.
Together, these studies motivate a benchmark that evaluates event-guided restoration across both underexposed and overexposed inputs.
blocks.zh:
事件摄像头同步记录每像素亮度变化并提供辅助测量 [3].
当常规框架退化时,它们的高时间分辨率和广泛的动态范围可以保持对比和移动提示。
事件并不直接提供密集的颜色或绝对的亮度,所以恢复需要RGB外观的聚变,事件变化,以及理想目标暴露的定义.
以往的事件制导低光研究,包括EvLowLight[13]和EvLight[4],提供了实验证据,证明事件测量可以在困难的照明中补充RGB输入.
SEE-Net [15] 随后将这一设置从固定的低度对正常的增强扩展至在低度、正常和亮度照射的亮度调整。
这些研究共同激励了一个基准,用于评价未充分接触和过度接触的投入中以事件为指南的恢复情况。

blocks.en:
Broad-range brightness adjustment couples several open design choices.
A complete system must represent asynchronous events, fuse them with RGB appearance, condition the desired brightness, and decide how much temporal context to use.
A shared challenge makes these choices observable under one data and evaluation protocol and provides reference points for subsequent research.
Organizing the challenge with the Event-Based Multimodal Vision Workshop also creates a focused forum for the event-vision community to compare system designs, discuss reproducibility, and identify limitations that are difficult to see from a single baseline.
blocks.zh:
广范围亮度调整夫妇若干开放设计选择.
一个完整的系统必须代表一个同步事件,使其与RGB的外观相融合,条件达到所期望的亮度,并决定使用的时间背景.
一项共同的挑战使这些选择在一个数据和评价协议下可以观察到,并为随后的研究提供了参考点。
与基于活动的多式联运展望讲习班一起组织挑战,还为活动-视觉界提供了一个重点突出的论坛,以比较系统设计,讨论可复制性,并找出从单一基线中难以看出的局限性。

blocks.en:
The SEE Challenge 2026 extends evaluation on SEE-600K [ 15 ] beyond a single baseline.
It supports a community study of independent event-guided restoration systems on newly recorded hidden sequences.
Around 70 teams registered interest, 15 accounts produced valid Phase 2 submissions, and six distinct teams completed organizer-side technical verification.
Their systems cover cross-attention, feature modulation, state-space models, latent flow, temporal averaging, cascaded restoration, and test-time augmentation.
This diversity allows the report to document both current performance and the practical trade-offs between accuracy, temporal context, model size, and inference multiplicity.
blocks.zh:
SEE挑战2026将SE-600K[15]的评价扩展至单一基线之外.
它支持对新记录的隐藏序列的独立事件制导恢复系统进行社区研究.
约70个小组登记了兴趣,15个帐户提交了有效的第二阶段报告,6个不同的小组完成了组织方技术核查。
他们的系统包括跨视线、特性调制、状态-空间模型、潜在流动、时间平均、级联恢复和试验时间增强。
这种多样性使报告能够记录当前的业绩以及准确性、时间背景、模型大小和推论多样性之间的实际权衡。

blocks.en:
This report makes four organizer-side contributions.
First, it defines the task and documents data construction, event–frame synchronization, the target-brightness statistic, and the open-system evaluation protocol.
Second, it reports a verified ranking based on organizer-run dense evaluation of the six systems for which checkpoints, code, and instructions were provided.
Third, it analyzes results across exposure settings, motion and texture cases, and a shared failure example using pixel-level, structural, and perceptual metrics.
Finally, it compares the architectural, conditioning, temporal, and inference choices of the submitted systems and identifies priorities for future challenge editions.
Because the competition permits different temporal contexts, pretrained weights, TTA, cascades, and post-processing, the ranking evaluates complete systems and does not isolate the contribution of any single component.
blocks.zh:
本报告提供了4个组织方的贡献。
首先,它定义了任务和记录数据构建、事件-帧同步、目标-光亮统计和开放系统评价协议。
第二,它报告根据组织者对提供检查站、代码和指示的六个系统的密集评价,对排名进行了核实。
第三,它利用像素水平、结构和感知度度量分析各种接触环境、运动和纹理案例的结果,以及一个共享的失败实例。
最后,它比较了所提交的系统的建筑、结构、时间和推论选择,并确定了今后挑战版的优先事项。
由于竞争允许不同时间背景,预先训练的权重,TTA,级联,以及后处理,排名评价了完整的系统,并不孤立任何单一组件的贡献.

blocks.en:
The challenge is an offline open-system evaluation.
No maximum value of K K or maximum temporal span was imposed, and participants were permitted to use both preceding and future adjacent frames from the provided sequence.
Participants could also choose their event representation, fusion strategy, training objective, and inference pipeline.
No constrained single-frame or single-pass track was defined retrospectively; temporal context and inference multiplicity are therefore disclosed as system properties rather than controlled variables.
blocks.zh:

没有规定KK的最高值或最长时间跨度,允许参加者使用先前和未来的相邻框架从所提供的序列中得出。
参与者还可以选择其活动代表、聚变战略、培训目标和推论管道。
没有回溯性地界定受约束的单一框架或单一通道;因此,时间上下文和推断的多重性被披露为系统属性,而不是受控制的变量。

blocks.en: 2.2 Dataset Splits and Pair Construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集分割和对等建设

blocks.en:
SEE-600K contains 610,126 image-event observations from 202 released real-world scenes [ 15 ] .
Each scene contains, on average, four recordings of the same environment and robotic-arm trajectory under different light-transmission, aperture, and exposure settings.
Neutral-density filters with different transmission levels create low-light, normal-light, and high-light recordings while the Universal Robots UR5e repeats the same trajectory.
After temporal registration, frames at corresponding trajectory positions are paired across exposure recordings.
An underexposed or overexposed frame can therefore be used as the source and a temporally corresponding normal-light frame as the target.
When a scene contains multiple eligible source or normal-light recordings, more than one restoration mapping can be constructed from the same underlying image-event observations.
This is why the number of constructed restoration pairs differs from the number of distinct image-event observations.
blocks.zh:
SEE-600K包含202发布真实世界场景中的610,126个图像事件观测[15].
每个场景平均包含在不同的光传输、孔径和曝光环境下对相同环境和机器人-臂轨迹的四张录音。
具有不同传输级别的中性密度滤波器会产生低光,普通光,高光的录音,而通用机器人UR5e则重复相同的轨迹.
在时间登记之后,相应轨迹位置的帧在接触记录之间成对。
因此,暴露不足或过度暴露的帧可以作为源头使用,而时间上对应的普通光帧作为目标.
当一个场景包含多个合格来源或普通光线录音时,可以从相同的基础图像-事件观测中构建一个以上的恢复映射.
这就是为什么构造的修复对的数量与不同的图像-事件观测数量不同的原因.

blocks.en:
The 165-scene training split and 37-scene released test split together form the 202 released SEE-600K scenes and yield 656,500 constructed restoration pairs.
The released references were available to all participants and supported training and Phase 1 validation.
The final evaluation used six additional newly recorded scene groups.
Only the input RGB data, events, metadata, and target-brightness statistic were released for these groups; their normal-light references remained hidden.
blocks.zh:
165场的训练分裂和37场的释放测试分裂一起形成了202场释放的SEE-600K场景,并产生656,500个构造的修复对.
向所有参与者提供了已公布的参考文献,并支持培训和第一阶段验证。
最后评价使用了另外六个新录制的场景组.
只有输入的RGB数据、事件、元数据和目标亮度统计为这些组发布;它们的正常亮度参考仍然隐藏。

The half-open interval prevents an event at a boundary from being assigned twice.
The released data contain 8-bit RGB PNG frames and timestamped event arrays with coordinates and polarity; the raw recordings were originally stored in AEDAT4 format together with IMU measurements.
The challenge does not prescribe a voxelization or event-window aggregation strategy.
Participants may transform the raw events into any representation and may combine events from multiple adjacent frame intervals when using temporal context.

blocks.en:
Repeated robotic-arm trajectories are temporally registered using the synchronized 1-kHz IMU signals [ 15 ] .
The dataset paper evaluates spatial alignment by matching SIFT features with FLANN, estimating an affine transformation with RANSAC, applying the transformation across the image, and averaging the resulting pixel displacement.
The reported mean displacement is 0.2967 pixels, with a temporal registration error of at most approximately 1 ms [ 15 ] .
These values characterize the acquisition and registration procedure.
blocks.zh:
重复的机器人-臂轨迹使用同步1-kHz IMU信号进行时间登记[15].
数据集文件通过将SIFT的特征与FLANN相匹配,估算与RANSAC的affine变换,在整个图像中应用变换,并平均由此产生的像素位移,来评价空间对齐.
所报告的平均迁移为0.2967像素,时间登记错误最多约为1 ms [15] 。
这些价值是购置和登记程序的特点。

blocks.en:
The hidden reference is read as an 8-bit sRGB image and converted to float32 by division by 255.
The mean is computed directly in the normalized sRGB domain, without inverse-gamma conversion, luminance weighting, a median operator, or separate per-channel prompts.
Thus, B ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] B\in[0,1] is a single float32 value computed independently for every target frame.
blocks.zh:
隐藏的参考文献被读作8位的sRGB图像,并以255的比分转换为浮点32.
平均值直接在正态的sRGB域中计算,不逆加马转换,亮度加权,中位运算符,或每个通道的单独提示符.
因此,B QQ [0, 1] B\ in [0, 1] 是每个目标框架独立计算的一个单一浮点32值.

blocks.en:
In the official evaluation, B B is calculated by the organizers from the hidden reference and supplied with the test input.
Participants cannot access I gt I_{\mathrm{gt}} , but they can use or ignore the scalar derived from it.
Accordingly, B B is privileged ground-truth-derived information, and the official benchmark is more precisely described as target-brightness-statistic-conditioned restoration.
Although an individual model may technically accept a user-selected value at inference time, the challenge results do not evaluate generalization to arbitrary user-selected brightness values.

在正式评价中,BB由组织者从隐藏的参考物中计算,并提供测试输入.

blocks.en: 2.5 Evaluation Protocol and Challenge Rules
blocks.zh: 2.5 评价议定书和质疑规则

blocks.en:
Predictions are evaluated in normalized RGB space without boundary cropping.
PSNR is the primary metric and determines the verified ranking; SSIM is secondary.
Both metrics are computed per frame and averaged separately over the Low-to-Normal and High-to-Normal subsets, and the reported average is the mean of the two subset scores.
L1 and LPIPS are additionally reported for the organizer-selected case analysis, but they do not affect the official ranking.
Parameters and FLOPs are descriptive and do not affect the ranking.
blocks.zh:
预测在正常的RGB空间中进行评估,不设边界裁剪.
PSNR是主要的衡量标准,决定了经过核实的排名;SSIM是次要的.
两个度量衡均按帧计算,并分别对低到度值和高到度值子集进行平均值,报告的平均值是两个子集分数的平均值.
L1和LPIPS被额外报道,用于组织者选择的病例分析,但不影响官方排名.
参数和FLOP是描述性的,不影响排名.

blocks.en:
Because of CodaBench storage and evaluation limits, the Phase 2 server evaluates one frame in every ten from each hidden video.
For technical verification, the organizers run the submitted checkpoints and inference code on the same hidden videos using dense temporal sampling.
All accounts were subject to the same phase-specific server settings and were limited to five submissions per day and 100 submissions per account in each phase.
The challenge website opened on May 10, 2026; the validation server opened on May 25; the hidden test data and Phase 2 server opened on June 25; submissions closed on July 3; and results were announced on July 10.
External public data and pretrained weights were permitted, provided that their use was disclosed in the technical report.
As noted above, the rules did not restrict temporal context and allowed future frames in this offline setting.
blocks.zh:
由于Coda Bench存储和评价的限制,第二阶段服务器从每个隐藏的视频中每10个帧评价一个帧.
为了进行技术核查,组织者使用密集的时间取样,对提交的检查站和同一隐藏视频的推断代码进行操作。
所有账户都受同一阶段特定服务器设置的制约,每个阶段每天提交5份,每个账户提交100份。
挑战网站于2026年5月10日开放;验证服务器于5月25日开放;隐藏测试数据和第二阶段服务器于6月25日开放;提交材料于7月3日关闭;结果于7月10日公布.
允许使用外部公共数据和预先受过训练的权重,条件是技术报告披露其使用情况。
如上所述,这些规则没有限制时间背景,并且允许今后在这一离线设定中设定框架。

blocks.en:
A valid CodaBench submission is a correctly formatted prediction package that was successfully evaluated by the Phase 2 server.
Fifteen such submissions/accounts were received.
Because a platform account does not by itself establish a distinct verified team identity, these submissions are not interpreted as 15 verified teams.
The six teams reported in this paper responded to the organizer invitation, confirmed their team identities, described their systems, and provided checkpoints, inference code, and instructions for organizer-side evaluation.
Only these six systems form the verified open-system ranking in this report.
blocks.zh:
一个有效的Coda Bench提交是一个正确的格式化的预测包,它得到了第二阶段服务器的成功评价.
共收到15份此类呈件/账目。
由于平台账户本身没有建立经过核实的团队身份,这些提交材料不解释为15个经过核实的团队。
本文中报告的6个小组对组织者的邀请作出了回应,确认了他们的小组身份,描述了他们的系统,并提供了检查站、推断代码和组织者评价的指示。
只有这六个系统构成本报告中经核实的开放系统排名。

blocks.en: 2.6 Prior Evidence and Official Baseline
blocks.zh: 2.6 先前证据和官方基线

blocks.en:
The effectiveness of event guidance is an established premise of the challenge rather than a conclusion drawn from its open-system ranking.
Prior event-guided low-light studies reported controlled comparisons supporting the complementary value of events under degraded illumination [ 13 , 14 , 4 ] .
SEE-Net [ 15 ] extended this line of work to broad-range brightness adjustment and analyzed brightness conditioning.
Its previously reported prompt-merge ablation on SDE reduced PSNR from 23.57 dB to 22.26 dB when prompt merging was disabled, while SSIM changed from 0.7724 to 0.7713; it also visualized outputs over a sweep of prompt values.
These are results from the prior SEE-Net study.
blocks.zh:
活动指导的有效性是挑战的一个既定前提,而不是从其开放系统的排名中得出的结论。
以往的事件引导低光研究报告了可控比较,支持在退化照明下的事件的补充价值[13、14、4]。
SEE-Net [15]将这一条工作线扩展至广域亮度调整,并分析了亮度调节.
其此前报道的SDE上的即时发生膨胀,当快速合并被禁用时,PSNR从23.57 dB降至22.26 dB,而SSIM则从0.7724改为0.7713;它还通过扫描即时值将输出可视化.
这些是先前东南欧网络研究的结果。

blocks.en:
The released SEE-Net baseline takes one RGB frame, a synchronized 64-bin event voxel grid, and a brightness statistic.
It uses separate RGB and event encoders, event-aware cross-attention, and a five-layer exposure decoder.
The model has 1.89M parameters and obtains 18.8279 dB PSNR and 0.6414 SSIM on the released test split.
These released-split results are provided for reference.
blocks.zh:
释放的SEE-Net基线需要一个RGB框架,一个同步的64-bin事件 voxel网格,以及亮度统计.
它使用单独的RGB和事件编码器,事件感知交叉注意,以及五层曝光解码器.
该型号有1.89M参数,并在释放的试验分裂上获得18.8279 dB PSNR和0.6414 SSIM.
提供了这些释放的分散结果供参考。

blocks.en: 3 Challenge Results and Organizer-Side Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 挑战结果和组织者-系统分析

blocks.en:
Table 2 : Results of the SEE Challenge 2026 under Phase 2 Codabench and organizer-side dense sampling.
Dense-sampling PSNR determines the ranking, while SSIM is secondary.
Best and second-best results are shown in bold and underlined .
FLOPs (G) and parameters are reported at the native resolution.
FLOPs (G) include cascaded stages but exclude TTA, temporal averaging, ensembles, and post-processing.
blocks.zh:
表2:第二阶段Codabench和组织者-侧密集取样下的SEE挑战2026的结果。
测试 PSNR决定排名,而SSIM是次要的.
最佳和次最佳成果以粗体和下划线表示。
FLOPs(G)和参数在原生分辨率上报告.
FLOP(G)包括级联阶段,但不包括TTA、时间平均、组合和加工后阶段。

blocks.en:
Verified Open-System Ranking. Table 2 reports the six verified systems under both Phase 2 CodaBench sampling and organizer-side dense sampling.
MLSLabs (CodaBench handle: pixelartai) ranks first under dense sampling with 23.1731 dB PSNR and 0.7237 SSIM, followed by ACVLab-TL (vincent2013) with 23.0873 dB and 0.7169 SSIM.
The PSNR difference between the top two systems is only 0.0858 dB.
We therefore describe their aggregate scores as closely spaced and do not interpret the average difference as evidence of a statistically meaningful separation.
blocks.zh:
验证的开放系统 Ranking. 表2报告在第二阶段Coda Bench取样和组织者-侧密集取样下六个经核查的系统。
MLSLabs (Coda Bench 手柄: 像素拉泰) 以23.1731 dB PSNR 和 0.7237 SSIM 位居密集采样第一位,其次是 ACVLab-TL (vincent2013) 和 23.0873 dB 和 0.7169 SSIM 。
前两个系统的PSNR差异只有0.0858 dB.
因此,我们将其总得分描述为距离很近,不把平均差值解释为统计上有意义的分离的证据。

blocks.en:
Dense sampling preserves the ordering observed on CodaBench.
Across all six systems, the absolute change from subsampled to dense evaluation is below 0.04 dB PSNR and 0.001 SSIM.
This agreement indicates that the one-in-ten CodaBench sampling provides a close estimate of the dense-sequence averages for these submissions, while the organizer-side run additionally verifies that the supplied code and checkpoints reproduce the submitted predictions.
blocks.zh:
Dense采样保留了在Coda Bench上观察到的订单.
在所有六个系统中,从子抽样评价到密集评价的绝对变化低于0.04 dB PSNR和0.001 SSIM。
该协议表明,Coda Bench抽样的十分之一对提交材料的密集序列平均值提供了精确的估计,而组织方则另外运行,核实所提供的代码和检查站复制了提交的预测。

blocks.en:
Performance Across Exposure Settings. All six systems obtain lower PSNR on Low-to-Normal than on High-to-Normal restoration.
For pixelartai, for example, the dense scores are 21.1863 dB and 25.1600 dB, respectively.
The consistent gap shows that the Low-to-Normal subset is empirically more difficult under this hidden-test composition.
It is consistent with the hypothesis that severe underexposure provides weaker and noisier RGB measurements, but the aggregate scores alone do not establish that mechanism; scene content, motion, event density, target distribution, and residual registration error may also contribute.
blocks.zh:
整个曝光设置的性能 。 所有6个系统在低到正常状态下得到的PSNR低于高到正常状态的恢复.
例如,对于像素阿尔泰来说,密集的分数分别为21.1863 dB和25.1600 dB.
持续的差距表明,在这种隐性测试构成下,低到自然子集在经验上更加困难.
这与以下假设是一致的:严重接触不足可提供较弱和噪声的RGB测量值,但总分单靠这个机制不能确定;场景内容,运动,事件密度,目标分布,剩余注册误差也可能有所贡献.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Performance comparison across different groups.
blocks.zh: 表3:不同组别的业绩比较。

blocks.en:
Representative Case Analysis. Table 3 reports three representative hidden groups selected to probe robot motion, repetitive checkerboard texture, and Chinese text.
The cases provide interpretable comparisons.
Among the three cases, Robot Motion (G1) yields the lowest PSNR for every submitted system.
ACVLab-TL (vincent2013) leads this case on PSNR, SSIM, L1, and LPIPS, with 18.85 dB PSNR and 0.5010 SSIM.
The uniformly lower scores are consistent with motion being an additional challenge, although one group cannot isolate motion from illumination, scene content, event density, or registration effects.
blocks.zh:
代表性案例分析。 表3报告了为探测机器人运动、重复检查板纹理和中文文本选定的三个代表性隐形组。
这些案件提供了可解释的比较。
在这3个案例中,机器人运动(G1)对每个提交系统的PSNR产量最低。
ACVLab-TL(Vincent2013)在PSNR,SSIM,L1和LPIPS上引领了这个案件,有18.85 dB PSNR和0.5010 SSIM.
统一较低的分数与运动是一项额外的挑战是一致的,尽管一个组无法将运动与照明、场景内容、事件密度或登记效果隔离开来。

blocks.en:
Checkerboard (G2) tests repetitive high-frequency structure.
EventFuse obtains the best PSNR and L1, MLSLabs (pixelartai) obtains the best SSIM, and ACVLab-TL obtains the best LPIPS.
The disagreement is small but informative: the three metrics favor different reconstructions of the same fine texture.
Chinese Text (G3) produces the highest PSNR of the three cases for all submitted systems.
ACVLab-TL leads PSNR, SSIM, and L1, whereas ACVLab-LCY (bucloud) obtains the lowest LPIPS.
This split again shows that pixel fidelity, structural similarity, and perceptual distance need not select the same system.
All submitted systems outperform the released SEE-Net baseline in the three cases, but the gains and metric ordering depend on the visual content.
Consequently, the average leaderboard should be read together with content-specific evidence.
blocks.zh:
检查板(G2)测试重复的高频结构.
EventFuse获得最佳PSNR和L1,MLSLabs(pixelartai)获得最佳SSIM,ACVLab-TL获得最佳LPIPS.
分歧虽小,但内容翔实:这三条标准有利于同一精细纹理的不同重建.
中文文本(G3)为所有提交系统的3个案例制作最高的PSNR.
ACVLab-TL领导PSNR,SSIM,和L1,而ACVLab-LCY(bucloud)获得的最低LPIPS.
这种分割再次表明,像素忠诚,结构相似,和感知距离不需要选择相同的系统.
所有提交的系统都超过了三个案例的SEE-Net发布基准,但收益和度量订购取决于视觉内容。
因此,应当结合具体内容的证据来阅读平均领导板。

blocks.en:
Organizer-Side Synthesis. Taken together, the results support three observations.
First, dense sampling confirms the aggregate ordering obtained by the server, but the 0.0858 dB gap between the top two systems remains too small to support a claim of clear separation.
Second, the named cases expose content-dependent behavior that is hidden by the average: motion lowers all reported PSNR values, repetitive texture produces metric disagreement, and Chinese text changes the relative perceptual ranking.
Third, the shared failure case shows that visibility recovery and detail recovery are distinct objectives under severe underexposure.
The disclosed system configurations help formulate hypotheses about temporal context, TTA, and model scale, but the open-system ranking cannot attribute any observation to one design choice.
A future challenge should therefore retain an open track while adding predeclared content strata and a constrained single-frame track for controlled comparisons.
blocks.zh:
组织者-系统合成. 总之,结果支持了三项意见。
首先,密集采样证实了服务器获得的总订单,但前两个系统之间的0.0858 dB差距仍然太小,无法支持明确分离的说法.
其次,被命名的案例暴露出由平均值隐藏的内容依赖行为:运动降低所有报告的PSNR值,重复的纹理产生度量分歧,中文文本改变相对的知觉排名.
第三,共同失败案例表明,可见度恢复和详细恢复是严重接触不足下的不同目标。
被披露的系统配置有助于对时间上下文,TTA,和模型尺度形成假说,但开放系统排名不能将任何观察归属于一个设计选择.
因此,今后的挑战应当保持开放的轨道,同时增加预先宣布的内容层和限制的单一框架轨道,以便进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en:
System Design and Inference Cost. The verified systems differ in backbone scale, event fusion, pretraining, temporal processing, and inference multiplicity.
Their parameter counts range from 1.16M for EventFuse to 54.21M for the two-stage EventRestormer pipeline, but model size alone does not explain the ranking.
Only Event-SCAM uses adjacent frames: its core network processes one RGB–event pair per call and conditionally averages outputs from the target frame and six neighboring frames.
The other five systems receive a single target frame and its associated events, even when they repeat inference on that input.
EventFuse performs one compact restoration pass; EventRestormer combines a two-stage cascade with eight-way TTA, resulting in 16 stage-level forward passes per output.
EvLCD and SEE-SplitNet each use four single-frame TTA variants, while REFM performs six Euler updates within one single-frame latent-transport pipeline.
blocks.zh:
系统设计和推论成本。 经核实的系统在骨干规模、事件聚变、预训、时间处理和推论多样性方面各不相同。
他们的参数计数范围从1.16M用于EventFuse,到54.21M用于两阶段Event Reformer管道,但单是模型大小并不能解释排名.
只有事件-SCAM使用相邻帧:其核心网络处理每个呼叫一个RGB-事件对,有条件地平均来自目标帧和六个相邻帧的输出.
其他五个系统得到一个单一的目标框架及其相关的事件,即使它们重复了对该输入的推论.
EventFuse执行一个紧凑的修复通道; EventReformer将双级级级联与八向TTA结合,每输出16个级前传通道.
EvLCD和SEE-SplitNet各使用四个单帧TTA变体,而REFM则在一个单帧潜在运输管道内进行六个Euler更新.

blocks.en:
The FLOPs in Table 2 describe the reported core networks and are not a standardized end-to-end cost measurement.
Moreover, the teams reported latency on different GPUs and software environments.
We therefore use the disclosed frame counts and inference passes to interpret efficiency and avoid presenting the reported FLOPs or latency as a controlled hardware comparison.
blocks.zh:
表2中的FLOP描述了报告的核心网络,而不是标准化的端到端成本计量.
此外,各小组报告了不同GPU和软件环境的延迟性。
因此,我们使用披露的帧计数和推断证来解释效率,避免将所报告的FLOP或延迟作为可控硬件的比较。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Qualitative comparison of the verified submissions on representative Low-to-Normal and High-to-Normal examples. Input RGB frames, event visualizations, reference images, restored outputs, and enlarged difficult regions are displayed with a common image range and without additional gamma or contrast adjustment. The examples illustrate differences in residual noise, color, local contrast, and texture recovery that are not fully captured by average PSNR and SSIM.
blocks.zh: 图2:经核实的低度和高度对度实例的定性比较。 输入RGB框架,事件可视化,参考图像,恢复输出,以及扩大的困难区域都以共同的图像范围显示,没有额外的γ或对比调整. 这些例子说明了在残留噪音、颜色、局部对比度和纹理恢复方面的差异,这些差异没有被一般的PSNR和SSIM完全抓住。

blocks.en:
Qualitative Observations. Figure 2 complements the numerical results.
The verified systems generally recover substantially more visible structure than the released baseline, especially in strongly degraded regions.
However, difficult examples still exhibit residual noise, color shifts, weakened texture, or local contrast errors.
The event visualization helps identify regions containing temporal contrast information, but its presence does not guarantee recovery when the RGB measurement is severely clipped or when the event signal is sparse or noisy.
These examples motivate evaluating both pixel-level fidelity and perceptual quality and show that the current task remains unsolved despite the improvement over the baseline.
blocks.zh:
定性观察. 图2补充了数字结果。
已核实的系统一般比释放的基线恢复明显得多,特别是在严重退化的区域。
然而,困难的例子仍然显示出残留的噪音,颜色变化,纹理减弱,或者局部对比错误.
事件可视化有助于识别包含时间对比信息的区域,但其存在并不能保证在RGB测量被严重剪辑或事件信号稀少或吵闹时恢复.
这些例子促使人们评价像素水平的忠诚度和知觉质量,并表明尽管比基线有所改善,但目前的任务仍未完成。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Representative shared failure case under severe underexposure. (a) Accumulated events, (b) input frame, (c) SEE-Net baseline, (d)–(e) and (g)–(j) verified submissions, and (f) ground-truth frame. The green boxes indicate the enlarged regions shown below. Although the submitted systems substantially brighten the input, none faithfully reconstructs the checkerboard structure. The values below each result denote PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS ( ↑ / ↑ / ↓ \uparrow/\uparrow/\downarrow ).
blocks.zh: 图3:代表共用的暴露严重不足的故障病例。 (a) 累积事件,(b) 输入框架,(c) SEE-Net基线,(d)-(e)和(g)-(j) 经核实的提交材料,(f) 地面真相框架。 绿色方框显示以下所显示的扩大区域。 虽然所提交的系统大大地提高了输入的亮度,但没有一个系统忠实地重建了检查板结构。 每个结果下方的值表示PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS(  / ↑ / ↓ / ↓ ) .

blocks.en:
Shared Failure Pattern. Figure 3 presents a severely underexposed example for which none of the evaluated systems faithfully reconstructs the local checkerboard structure.
All verified submissions improve substantially over the SEE-Net baseline, which obtains 12.74 dB PSNR, 0.4451 SSIM, and 0.4659 LPIPS.
Nevertheless, the best submitted PSNR is only 18.73 dB, the best SSIM is 0.5200, and the best LPIPS is 0.2688; these values are achieved by different systems.
The methods largely correct global brightness, but their enlarged crops share blurred square boundaries, weakened contrast, and color shifts relative to the reference.
The event visualization contains activity around the scene structure, yet the nearly black RGB crop provides weak appearance and color measurements.
This single example does not isolate the cause of failure, but it identifies a common limitation: event-guided exposure correction can restore visibility without recovering fine local texture faithfully.
blocks.zh:
共享失败模式 。 图3显示一个严重暴露不足的例子,其中没有任何一个被评价的系统忠实地重建了当地的跳棋结构。
所有经核实的提交材料都大大改进了SEE-Net基线,基线得到12.74 dB PSNR、0.4451 SSIM和0.4659 LPIPS。
尽管如此,提交最好的PSNR只有18.73 dB,最好的SSIM是0.5200,最好的LPIPS是0.2688;这些值是通过不同的系统实现的.
这些方法基本上纠正了全球的亮度,但是其扩大的作物有模糊的方形界限,对比弱化,与参考物相对的颜色变化.
事件可视化包含围绕场景结构的活动,然而近黑色的RGB作物提供弱的外观和色彩测量.
这个单一的例子并不孤立故障的原因,但它确定了一个共同的限制:事件引导的曝光修正可以在不忠实地恢复精细的局部纹理的情况下恢复可见度.

blocks.en: 4 Participating Methods
blocks.zh: 4 参与 方法

blocks.en:
This section summarizes the six verified systems using a common set of dimensions.
Complete architecture diagrams, training configurations, and team-provided descriptions are included in the supplementary material.
Table 4 provides a standardized comparison of pretraining, brightness conditioning, TTA, temporal processing, and inference multiplicity.
It separates multi-frame temporal processing from repeated inference on one frame: Event-SCAM is the only submitted system that aggregates adjacent-frame outputs, while the other five systems use a single target-frame input.
The descriptions below focus on the design choices needed to interpret the challenge results.
blocks.zh:
本节概述使用一套共同维度的六个经核实的系统。
补充材料包括完整的结构图、培训配置和团队提供的描述。
表4提供了预训、亮度调节、TTA、时间处理和推论多重性的标准比较。
它将多帧时间处理与一个帧的反复推论区分开来: Event-SCAM是唯一提交的系统,它汇总了相邻的帧输出,其他五个系统则使用单一的目标帧输入.
以下描述侧重于解释挑战结果所需的设计选择.

blocks.en:
Table 4 : Comparison of training and inference strategies adopted by the participating teams and the SEE baseline.
All methods use the brightness prompt. Effective Passes denotes the number of model forward passes or iterative updates used during inference.
blocks.zh:
表4:各参与小组采用的培训和推断战略与东南欧基线的比较。
所有方法都使用亮度提示. 有效通行证表示推论期间使用的型号前传通行证或迭代更新的次数.

blocks.en:
MLSLabs (pixelartai). Event-SCAM uses NAFBlocks and bidirectional cross-attention to fuse RGB and event features.
It is trained for 300 epochs on SEE-600K with Charbonnier and gradient losses, without external data or pretrained weights.
The core network processes one frame–event pair per call.
When the event count is below 3200, the method averages the target-frame output with three preceding and three succeeding outputs; otherwise, it returns only the target-frame prediction.
Event-SCAM is the only multi-frame submission and uses up to seven single-frame calls.
blocks.zh:
MLSLabs (pixelartai) (英语). Event-SCAM使用NAFBlocks和双向交叉注意来将RGB和事件特性引信.
它在SEE-600K上的300个纪元上接受培训,带有Charbonnier和梯度损失,没有外部数据或预先训练的权重.
核心网络每个呼叫处理一个帧-事件对.
当事件计数低于3200时,该方法将目标框架产出的平均值为前三个和后三个产出;否则,它只返回目标框架的预测.
Event-SCAM是唯一的多帧提交,使用最多7个单帧调用.

blocks.en:
ACVLab-TL (vincent2013). EventRestormer uses a four-level Restormer RGB backbone, a 64-bin event encoder, and spatial FiLM fusion.
A seven-dimensional vector formed from B B and RGB statistics conditions its latent and decoder stages, while public Restormer denoising weights initialize the RGB backbone.
Its two-stage cascade applies eight-way dihedral TTA to the same target frame and event grid, producing 16 stage-level passes without adjacent frames.
blocks.zh:
ACVLab-TL(文森特2013). 事件重暴器使用四级重暴器RGB主干线,64bin事件编码器,以及空间FiLM聚变.
从B B 和 RGB 统计中形成的七维矢量使其潜伏和解码阶段处于条件,而公共重暴器去诺重则初始化了 RGB 骨干.
其两级级联将八向二面体TTA应用到同一个目标框架和事件网格上,产生16个没有相邻框架的阶段级通过.

blocks.en:
EventFuse. EventFuse processes one RGB frame and a 64-bin event voxel grid using Bayer and coordinate encodings, a Mamba-based illumination estimator, bidirectional fusion, and sparse state-space blocks.
Its decoder is conditioned on B B , and the model is trained on the official data without external data or pretrained weights.
With 1.16M parameters, it is the smallest verified model and restores each frame in one pass.
blocks.zh:
活动Fuse。 EventFuse处理一个RGB框架和一个64-bin事件 voxel网格,使用Bayer和坐标编码,一个基于Mamba的照明估计器,双向聚变,以及稀疏的状态空间块.
其解码器以B B为条件,该模型是在没有外部数据或预先训练权重的情况下对官方数据的训练.
用1.16M参数,它是最小的可验证模型,并在一个通过中恢复每个帧.

blocks.en:
ACVLab-LCY (bucloud). EvLCD estimates an exposure-corrected base image from local color distributions and predicts a residual with a 64-bin event encoder and FiLM-conditioned U-Net.
It is trained from scratch on the official data in two stages.
Inference averages four flipped predictions of the same frame and shifts their global mean to match B B .
blocks.zh:
ACVLab-LCY (布云). EvLCD从本地颜色分布中估算出一个曝光校正的底像,并预测一个64位事件编码器和FiLM有条件的U-Net的剩余.
它分两个阶段从零开始接受官方数据培训。
推论平均对同一个框架进行四个翻转的预测,并改变其全球平均值以匹配B B.

blocks.en:
VisionLab-JB (bin_jiang). REFM treats restoration from one RGB–event input as rectified-flow transport in a learned RGB latent space.
A velocity field fuses a binary event voxel grid with an exposure descriptor derived from source brightness and B B , then performs six Euler updates from the observed latent state.
The 3.06M-parameter pipeline uses only the official training data and decodes the updated latent representation once.
blocks.zh:
远景Lab-JB (bin_jiang). REFM将一个RGB-事件输入的恢复视为在学习到的RGB潜在空间中纠正流运输.
速度场将二进制事件 voxel 网格引信,其曝光描述符来自源亮度和B ,然后从观测到的潜在状态进行六次欧拉更新。
3.06M参数管道只使用官方培训数据,并破解一次更新的潜在表述。

blocks.en:
aka18. SEE-SplitNet trains wider exposure-specific SEE-Net variants for Low-to-Normal and High-to-Normal restoration.
It sets C 1 = 128 C_{1}=128 and C 2 = 128 C_{2}=128 , conditions on B B with a 7-layer exposure MLP, and uses progressive patch-size training followed by PSNR-oriented fine-tuning.
Inference selects the task-specific model and applies four TTA variants to the same target frame.
blocks.zh:
aka18. SEE-SplitNet为低度对正态和高度对正态的恢复,培训了更广泛的接触特定SEE-Net的变体。
它设置了C 1 = 128 C_{1}=128和C 2 = 128 C_{2}=128,在B B上设置了7层曝光的MLP条件,并采用渐进的补丁尺寸训练,之后进行PSNR导向的微调.
推论选择任务特定模型,并将四个TTA变体应用到同一个目标框架.

blocks.en:
Event fusion differs across the submitted architectures.
Five systems use one target frame.
Event-SCAM instead conditionally aggregates adjacent-frame outputs.
Repeated inference and multi-frame processing are separate system properties.
blocks.zh:
提交架构的事件组合不同。
五个系统使用一个目标框架。
相邻框架产出的有条件汇总。
重复推论和多帧处理是独立的系统属性.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Contributing teams, participant names, and affiliations for the verified systems summarized in this paper.
blocks.zh: 表5:本文件概述的经核实的系统的贡献小组、参与者姓名和隶属关系。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
The challenge and this report have several limitations.
First, the verified ranking is open-system: systems use different frame counts, future context, pretraining, cascades, TTA, temporal averaging, and post-processing.
It measures complete submitted pipelines and cannot isolate the contribution of events or any individual component.
Prior work provides the modality-level motivation, but no new matched RGB-only retraining was conducted on the hidden set.
The participating teams supplied checkpoints and inference code, so a fair organizer-run modality ablation for the submitted systems was not available.
blocks.zh:
挑战和本报告有一些局限性。
首先,经核实的排名是开放系统:系统使用不同的帧计数,未来上下文,预训,级联,TTA,时间平均,以及后处理.
它测量提交的完整管道,不能孤立事件或任何个别部分的促成。
先前的工作提供了模式级的动力,但是没有在隐藏的集合上进行新的匹配的仅RGB的再培训.
参与小组提供检查站和推断码,因此无法为所提交的系统提供公平的组织者运作模式。

blocks.en:
Second, the official target-brightness statistic is derived from each hidden reference.
It is privileged information and differs from a practical setting in which a user selects a desired brightness without access to ground truth.
Although SEE-Net previously visualized different prompt values, the challenge did not conduct a standardized quantitative sweep measuring monotonicity or output-brightness error for all submitted methods.
blocks.zh:
第二,官方目标亮度统计来源于每个隐藏的参考文献.
这是一种特权信息,不同于用户在不获取地面真相的情况下选择理想亮度的实际环境。
虽然SEE-Net以前可视化了不同的即时值,但挑战并没有对所有提交的方法进行标准化的量化扫描,测量单调性或输出-亮度错误。

blocks.en:
Third, the evaluation emphasizes frame-wise PSNR and SSIM.
The representative case table adds L1 and LPIPS, and the failure figure exposes one shared qualitative weakness, but these selected examples do not replace a complete per-sequence distribution.
The challenge also does not include a temporal-consistency metric, a systematic analysis against event rate or scene motion, or a scene-level bootstrap confidence interval.
Accordingly, small score differences should not be interpreted as statistically established separations.
blocks.zh:
第三,评价强调框架式PSNR和SSIM。
代表性案例表增加了L1和LPIPS,失败数字暴露出一个共同的质量弱点,但这些选定的例子并不能取代完整的逐序分布.
挑战也不包括时间一致性指标、对事件速率或场景运动的系统分析,或场景级的靴子置信间隔。
因此,小分数差异不应解释为按统计确定的离职。

blocks.en:
Finally, the reported computation and latency values were produced by teams on different hardware and may exclude parts of the full inference pipeline.
Conditional temporal averaging also makes the effective cost input-dependent.
blocks.zh:
最后,报告的计算值和延迟值是由不同硬件的团队产生的,可能排除了部分完整的推论管道.
有条件的时间平均也使有效的成本投入依赖。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented the SEE Challenge 2026, an open-system benchmark for event-guided, target-brightness-statistic-conditioned restoration across a broad illumination range.
Fifteen valid CodaBench submissions were received, and six distinct teams completed organizer-side verification and are included in the reported ranking.
Dense sampling produced results close to the subsampled server evaluation, while exposure-specific and content-oriented analyses showed that Low-to-Normal restoration obtains lower scores and that the best method varies across cases and metrics.
The shared failure example further shows that correcting global brightness does not ensure faithful recovery of fine local texture under severe underexposure.
The submitted systems explore diverse RGB-event fusion, conditioning, temporal, and inference strategies.
The challenge provides a common protocol and identifies open questions in exposure recovery, efficiency, temporal consistency, and practical brightness control.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了SEE Challenge 2026,这是一个开放系统的基准,用于在大范围照明范围内,以事件为导向,目标亮度,统计为条件的恢复.
收到了15份有效的Coda Bench材料,6个不同的小组完成了组织方核查,并被列入报告的排名。
Dense采样得出了接近子抽样服务器评价的结果,而针对接触情况的分析以及面向内容的分析显示,低到正常恢复得到的分数较低,最佳方法因案例和度量而异。
共同失败的例子进一步表明,纠正全球亮度并不能确保在严重接触不足的情况下忠实地恢复精细的局部纹理。
提交的系统探索了多种RGB-event聚变,调制,时间,以及推论策略.
这一挑战提供了一个共同的协议,并确定了暴露恢复、效率、时间一致性和实际亮度控制方面的未决问题。

blocks.en: Acknowledgements: The organizers thank all participants and particularly the six verified teams that provided checkpoints, inference code, technical descriptions, and supplementary method reports.
blocks.zh: 致谢: 组织者感谢所有与会者,特别是提供检查站、推断代码、技术说明和补充方法报告的六个经核实的小组。
